Catalog app of the Iris UI kit (alpha). Download `Iris-Catalog.apk` below and install it on an Android phone (Android 8+, blur needs Android 12+). Allow installs from this source when asked. Uninstall an older version first: the signing key changed.

## What changed since 0.1.0-alpha

### Shapes
- **Pills are squircles now.** The new `SmoothPillShape` (superellipse ends) replaces the plain 50 % rounded shape for the bottom nav pill, buttons, segmented tabs, chips, the search bar and the buttons of dialogs.
- The clear button of text fields, the dot on chips and the badges use the same squircle pill instead of a plain circle.

### Popup menu
- The divider between groups is now the same one-pixel hairline as in lists, inset by the row padding. It was a thick grey band that looked like a rendering bug.

### Catalog
- Removed the "Blur background" screen (the glass panel) together with its screenshots and recording, and the "Glass buttons" recording.

### Build and release
- The APK is now the **optimized release build** (it was a debug build), signed with the debug key.
- The release workflow keeps only `Iris-Catalog.apk` in a release.
- The version of the app is 0.1.1-alpha.

### Docs
- New logo and social preview image, the GIFs now come before the dark and light screenshots in the README, star history, copyright notice, API reference regenerated.

### Not squircles yet
Parts that the kit draws itself are still plain rounded shapes: the switch (track and thumb), the slider (bar and dot), progress bars and rings, the inner shapes of the segmented tabs and the checkbox.
